name: Handyman.ai
long_description:
While building WeReno.com, we managed over $1B in renovations and noticed something: property owners kept coming back long after projects ended. We realized buildings have no memory, and every repair, maintenance issue, and service request starts from scratch.

So we built Handyman.ai, an AI agent that remembers your property, anticipates problems, and handles everything from maintenance to repairs.

In our first few months, we facilitated over $10M in GMV, validating the opportunity to build an AI agent for every property.
one_liner: Handyman.ai by WeReno | The AI Agent That Knows and Runs Your Property

founders.title: CEO and Founder
founders.founder_bio: I’m the founder of Handyman.ai by WeReno. After a decade building companies across security, construction, and technology and working on $1B+ in renovations, we realized buildings had no memory. We built Handyman.ai to change that, facilitating $10M+ in GMV in our first few months.
